display.name: Cortex
display.blurb: Work with your Cortex catalog from a session: entities, scorecards, teams, custom data, deploys, dependencies, and CQL queries. Built by Cortex. Authenticated with a workspace API key brokered at the egress proxy, or with a person's own access token.

token.hint: Create a personal access token under your avatar → Settings → Preferences → My access tokens. It carries your own Cortex permissions.

cli.doc:
Use `cortex` to work with the Cortex internal developer portal from this session: browse and search catalog entities, read scorecards and scores, look up teams and on-call, read and write custom data, record deploys and custom events, manage dependencies, and run CQL queries. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the workspace API key (or the launching person's own access token) as `Authorization: Bearer` on requests to the configured Cortex API host; `CORTEX_API_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login. `CORTEX_API_HOST` names the host the administrator selected (US, EU, or self-hosted); the CLI reads it, so do not override it.

Entities are addressed by tag (for example `payments-api`) or id. Find tags with `cortex entities` or `cortex search`.

Commands and the power each needs:
  cortex entities [field=value ...]           List entities, paged (catalog:read). Filters: types=service, owners=team-tag, query=text, page=0, pageSize=50
  cortex search <text> [field=value ...]      Search entities by text (catalog:read)
  cortex entity <tag>                         One entity, with owners and hierarchy (catalog:read)
  cortex descriptor <tag>                     The entity's YAML descriptor (catalog:read)
  cortex scorecards                           List scorecards (scorecards:read)
  cortex scorecard <tag>                      One scorecard (scorecards:read)
  cortex scores <scorecard-tag> [entity-tag]  Scores for a scorecard, optionally one entity's (scorecards:read)
  cortex entity-scorecards <tag>              Every scorecard result for one entity (catalog:read)
  cortex teams                                List teams (teams:read)
  cortex team <tag>                           One team (teams:read)
  cortex oncall <tag>                         Who is on call for an entity now (catalog:read)
  cortex custom-data <tag> [key]              Custom data on an entity, or one key (catalog:read)
  cortex set-custom-data <tag> <key> <json>   Add or replace one custom-data key; the value is JSON (custom-data:write)
  cortex events <tag>                         Custom events on an entity (catalog:read)
  cortex add-event <tag> <type> <title> [json]   Record a custom event; the optional JSON is its payload (events:write)
  cortex deploys <tag>                        Deploys recorded for an entity (catalog:read)
  cortex add-deploy <tag> <environment> <sha> [type]   Record a deploy; type defaults to DEPLOY (deploys:write)
  cortex dependencies <tag>                   Outbound dependencies of an entity (catalog:read)
  cortex add-dependency <caller> <callee> [json]   Add a dependency edge (dependencies:write)
  cortex query <cql>                          Run a CQL query and wait for its result (queries:read)
  cortex initiatives                          List initiatives (initiatives:read)
  cortex get <path> [field=value ...]         Raw GET under /api/v1 (the matching *:read power)
  cortex api <METHOD> <path> [json-body]      Raw call with an explicit method and optional JSON body (the matching power)

Paths that do not start with /api are prefixed with /api/v1/. Responses are JSON; list endpoints page with `page` (0-based) and `pageSize`. A path your profile did not grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated. Rate limit: 1000 requests per minute per client; a 429 carries Retry-After.
